integrity: Standalone deterministic finite checker included; exhaustive tests are corroboration, not the unrestricted proof. Novelty is subject to unindexed literature; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: All cycle sizes n>=3 and every dihedral subgroup for two-independence complexes; reflection fixed spaces are homotopy equivalent, not asserted PL-homeomorphic, to spheres before collapse. Cyclic ordinary homotopy classification uses Deshpande-Singh Theorem 4.6. No higher independence parameters or groups beyond natural dihedral actions.
title: Dihedral subgroup fixed spaces of two-independence complexes of cycles
